assertion_audit.test_both_panels_parse_and_name_both_sta: Missing, tiny, malformed, non-SVG or unlabelled panels fail their respective guards; a missing document citation fails membership; altered coordinates fail comparison against the separately stored digest, while the reused owner normalizes volatile fields.
assertion_audit.test_every_container_closes: Deleting an opening or closing section, paragraph, table, figure, pre, tbody, thead or tr produces unequal counts and fails; matching counts alone does not prove arbitrary nesting.
assertion_audit.test_every_element_identifier_is_unique: Restoring the duplicated section/pre nova-fit id yields a nonempty duplicate set and fails.
assertion_audit.test_every_paragraph_opens_and_closes_in: Reinstating nested paragraphs, orphan closing paragraphs or an unclosed paragraph fails the corresponding depth assertion.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_cites_the_check_that_gua: Deleting either receipt.json or the tests/ path from the fragment fails its corresponding membership assertion.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_every_state_it_ta: Changing a required formatted raw-state value in the fragment while retaining its independently stored receipt value fails the missing-values assertion; global text membership does not bind values to specific table cells.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_the_amplitude_tra: An amplitude that disagrees with the projection of the independently stored profile arrays fails pytest.approx; changing or removing a required amplitude or percentage in the document fails text membership.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_the_bands_it_meas: Reinstating 0.42 percent rather than 0.41 fails expected and forbidden text checks; removing the q95-failure wording or claiming all five pass fails literal checks; raw receipt values crossing any of its band thresholds fail numerical inequalities.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_the_control_ratio: Changing the fragment control-current fraction or span ratio without changing raw currents and spans makes expected text absent; this does not directly assert that the control leaves the 1.5 percent band relative to the original generating state.
assertion_audit.test_the_record_quotes_the_nova_fit_it_m: Missing nominal coefficients, singular values, residuals or current text fails membership; a receipt control marked converged, absent converged=false text, or either banned historical control value fails its explicit assertion.
assertion_audit.test_the_solver_lines_are_quoted_and_the: Removing either older solver line or every configuration-read phrase fails, but reverting the new q95 or edge-control analysis does not; this is the durability finding.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares a runtime result with the same variable supplied to that runtime call. Receipt-to-fragment and projection-to-stored-amplitude comparisons use separately stored expectations; panel hashes compare to a stored digest. Their protection is artifact consistency and structure, not solver behavior, and changing receipt and prose together can evade many assertions.
call_site_search: Exact-head git grep under nova/, scripts/ and benchmarks/ found no references; the same pattern found the known test and fragment references as a positive control. These are documentary/test artifacts with no changed production entry point.
figure_review: Rendered both exact-head SVG blobs with ImageMagick, inspected both PNGs: legible legends, both contour sets, wall and null markers visible, no clipped or colliding text; no blocking figure finding. ImageMagick emitted a read-only /tmp delegate warning but produced both complete images, which were opened and inspected.

findings.text: The record explicitly reports a q95 magnitude gap of 0.148 against the 0.1 acceptance ceiling, and the live plan s8 still requires both codes to meet that ceiling; the matched-definition 0.065 probe is explicitly not substituted for that gate, so completion requires either evidence meeting the declared measure or an authorized plan clarification/change accepting the measured outcome.

The provenance assertions still cover only DYNAMIC_NDEG, DESIGN_RANK and the phrase configuration read; the committed receipt and tests contain no LLS_COND, matched-definition q95 table, edge-off live-count pair or control endpoints, so reverting the latest repair to 13ac097713c505a8c7f221092937606cf73944f2 leaves the recorded 11-test gate green; fold these fields and checks into efit-on-nova-rows or explicitly exempt this durability gap.

This sentence calls the single-calculator 0.065 the definitional share, whereas :96 and :101 identify it as the residual reconstruction difference and attribute 0.083 to the definitions; use the same identities throughout so downstream readers do not invert the decomposition; fold the wording correction into efit-on-nova-rows or exempt it explicitly.
